title: setaria italica var. macrostachya
intro: Setaria italica var. macrostachya, commonly known as foxtail millet, is a type of cereal grain plant that belongs to the Poaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and supporting digestive health. The therapeutic actions of foxtail millet include its ability to act as a demulcent, soothing and protecting mucous membranes, and as an emollient, softening and soothing skin irritations. The bioactive constituents of foxtail millet include phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
